questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law you must obey. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a traffic law you must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers. They tell you about nearby rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other helpful services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is prohibited. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign means a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply. Slow down as much as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are traffic laws that you must follow. This sign prohibits right turns where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings or symbols. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: A yellow "Exit only" sign on a highway sign means your lane will become an exit ramp. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue through the interchange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign means a school zone is ahead or you are in one. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that pedestrians may cross here. If someone is crossing in a marked crosswalk, you must stop and wait until they finish crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a curve is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is ahead. Enter it slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to a school zone. Some of these signs mark crosswalks in school areas where children or pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.
